label: If some pair compares in the supplied esse respect, some in-act…, by Order by approach: the…
rule: Order by approach: the primary is maximal (ApproachToPrimaryReading.isMaximumIn_primary)
meaning: On the order of being by approach to a primary (ST I q.3 a.5 ad 2) with strict primacy (an open premise), the primary has being and nothing is more a being than it: anything that were would approach more nearly than the primary, while everything else approaches less nearly. So there is a maximum in being, whether or not grades are found.
